description: This file contains utility functions for testing Mattermost server configurations, plugins, licenses, and feature flags using Playwright. It includes functions to verify server setup, plugin status, licenses, and feature flags, as well as to ensure server deployment and plugin loading.

methods.name: shouldHaveCallsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the calls feature is enabled in the server configuration.

methods.name: shouldHaveFeatureFlag
methods.description: Verifies if a specific feature flag is set to the expected value.

methods.name: shouldRunInLinux
methods.description: Ensures the test is running on a Linux platform.

methods.name: ensureLicense
methods.description: Checks if the server has a valid license, requests a trial license if not licensed.

methods.name: requestTrialLicense
methods.description: Requests a trial license from the server with predefined contact and company info.

methods.name: skipIfNoLicense
methods.description: Skips tests if the server is not licensed.

methods.name: skipIfFeatureFlagNotSet
methods.description: Skips tests if a specific feature flag is not set to the expected value.

methods.name: ensureServerDeployment
methods.description: Verifies the server deployment configuration, especially for HA clusters.

methods.name: ensurePluginsLoaded
methods.description: Ensures specified plugins are installed and active on the server.
